project: QORE-VLM strict full NQ-Open eligible-universe gold bottleneck audit

baseline.entry_point: NQ-Open validation population -> official DPR gold-info contexts -> Wiki-DPR Top-50 -> frozen QORE + DPR Answer Scorer Top-5 -> unchanged Generator/evaluator observer
baseline.equivalence_test: The audit observes canonical IDs and frozen baseline outputs after normal retrieval/selection; official gold values never control retrieval, selection, prompting, generation, or evaluation.

core_invariants: The source population is the complete NQ-Open validation population of 3,610 questions; official DPR gold-info has 1,868 target rows with a non-empty context and 1,742 rows with an empty or missing context. Title is not an eligibility requirement.
Exact normalized question identity and strict unique Wiki-DPR passage identity are required; fuzzy joins, answer matching, title-only matching, and manual repair are forbidden.
The 1,868 eligible rows are an analysis universe, not a production label source; all 3,610, exact joins, empty contexts, mapping failures, and exclusions remain explicitly accounted for.
Oracle Top-5 is an evidence-coverage ceiling only: if at least one strict gold passage is in frozen Top-50, an oracle Top-5 could contain evidence; gold is never inserted into a prompt.

Only rows with mapping_status=mapped may carry retrieval-hit, selected-hit, or oracle-ceiling signals; partial, unresolved, and ambiguous mappings retain accounting only and cannot be attributed to the online path.
Production retrieval, selector, Generator, evaluator, labels, selected order, and answer path remain unchanged.
Compact outputs contain only IDs, question fingerprints, counts, booleans, buckets, hashes, and manifests; no questions, passages, answers, predictions, prompts, titles, or text are emitted.

interfaces.output_schema: aggregate population accounting and exact join statuses
invariants: Preflight runs without Wiki-DPR, model loading, retrieval, selection, generation, or evaluation.

interfaces.output_schema: canonical passage IDs with strict/partial/unmapped status
invariants: Every positive must map uniquely for a strict mapped row.

interfaces.input_schema: frozen Top-50 IDs, frozen QORE Top-5 IDs, unchanged Generator/evaluator outputs
interfaces.output_schema: compact evidence ceiling and retrieval/selector/generator strata
invariants: Observer outputs cannot feed any production decision.

plugins.hypothesis: The official NQ-test gold-info population exactly covers the NQ-Open validation question identities.
The 1,868 non-empty official contexts define a traceable conditional audit universe while retaining the 3,610-question denominator.
plugins.input_schema: official DPR nq-test_gold_info with non-empty context strings
plugins.output_schema: aggregate source accounting and eligible exact-join rows

plugins.hypothesis: Official positives can be uniquely mapped to the current Wiki-DPR corpus using official ID or exact title/full-text identities.
plugins.input_schema: eligible official positives and Wiki-DPR rows

plugins.insertion_point: after unchanged retrieval, QORE, Generator, and evaluator
plugins.hypothesis: Top-50 gold availability, Top-5 gold selection, and selected-hit generation correctness identify the dominant conditional bottleneck.
plugins.input_schema: canonical IDs and normal baseline outputs

plugins.insertion_point: compact summary after the frozen observer
plugins.hypothesis: Explicit denominators and three-way strata prevent source coverage from being mistaken for a production bottleneck.
plugins.output_schema: population, mapping, evidence-ceiling, and bottleneck summaries

composition.merge_rule: Only canonical IDs and compact aggregate values cross observer stages; no official gold content reaches the online path.
interaction_ablations: 3,610 all-question denominator versus 1,868 eligible conditional denominator
Top-50 evidence ceiling versus frozen QORE Top-5 selected evidence
retrieval miss versus selector miss versus selected-hit generation error

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic fixtures prove that gold alignment changes only observer counts and cannot mutate frozen retrieval or selection inputs.
tests: empty-context exclusion and exact join status accounting
strict official ID/title-text/full-text mapping and ambiguity
oracle Top-5 evidence ceiling is Top-50 availability only
Top-5 IDs are a subset of Top-50 IDs
preflight does not load Wiki-DPR or model
baseline equivalence and no gold feedback to selector

reproducibility.dataset_identity: NQ-Open validation all 3,610; official DPR nq-test_gold_info; Wiki-DPR psgs_w100.nq.compressed; Top-50; QORE + DPR Answer Scorer K=5
reproducibility.environment: Manifest records resolved source path/bytes/SHA-256, config hash, code revision/tree hash, Python identity, model ID/revision/config hash, and output hash.

limitations: The 1,868-row eligible universe is conditional source coverage based only on non-empty official context strings and does not represent all 3,610 questions.
The oracle field is an evidence-coverage ceiling, not an oracle generated answer or utility score.
Mapping failure is a source/corpus-version limitation and cannot be attributed to retrieval or QORE.
The full run is collaborator-side; no complete Wiki-DPR data or GPU experiment is run during implementation.
